content: Netaneme Wai Pii Dapiti Lamaiya
Kiŋi Dapiti banya anda dokona kapa palu pisipiyamo dokopa Kamongo dokome banya nyisu petenge dupwame pyasasaramiŋi lapala nyiso kyawa lete nyiya.

Dokopa kiŋi dokome poropeta akali Netane lamaiyuo lao, Namba dae isa sita lengeme anda pisi dokona palo. Dopa pipunupape Kamongona Kana Minyuo Lalu Lao Lenge Pii Palenge Bokote doko mee komau anda pisi dokona silyamo. Doko kapa daa, leya.
Dokopa Netaneme isingi lao, Emba keta Kamongo doko karamo dokome embena suu pinginya pinya suu pilini dupwa pipi, leya.
Leyamopape yuu gii kukwa dokopa Kamongome Netane dopa lamaiyuo lao,
Nambana kendemande akali Dapiti doko kando nambame lalamo lao lamaila pupi. Embame ingyuo nambana tembole anda doko pyaka nare, lape.
Nambame Isaraele wambu dupwa yuu Isipi piso kiiramo nyuo lanyuo epeyono yuu gii dokona piso pao dakepa nambana tembole anda mende pyaka nayami. Namba mee komau anda dokona iki palipapu papyuo kareyo.

Namba Isaraele wambu dupwa pipya papyuo karapunu dupwana nambame akali mupwa rombo palyiyunu dupwa kando, Akipamo nakamame isa sita lenge dokome nambana tembole anda mende pyaka nalyamisi? lao piso see nalu nange.

Dokona lao nambana kendemande Dapiti lamaipi, Namba Kamongo Porai Wakasa dokome emba mena sipisipi rapu pyuo kakopasa karenepa nyepala emba nambana Isaraele wambu dupwana kiŋi ingyuo karare lao rombo palyiyu kande.

Nambame emba peene dupwa peparae role peyo. Dee nambame embena nyisu petenge dupwa nyuo isa palyakayo. Dee yuu muu dupwana akali mupwa porai lapo kingi ketae pupyamo karaminyi dopale ingyuo embena kingi andake ingyuo ketae nembakaro.

Nambana Isaraele wambu dupwa nambame yuu mende rombo palyuo nyakamiyu dokona nakama au pyuo palyuo kararami. Dokopa nakama wambu koo mendemepe pyaope randa maiyuope pii nalu narami. Wamba kanda soo yuu dakena epo piso pao epapu karaminyi dokopape wambu koo dupwame nakama pyao randa maiyuo kareyami. Dopa piyaminyipape deeko dopa pii nara ingilyamo. Embena nyisu petenge dupwame pyasasaramiŋi lapala nambame emba kyawa lete nyuo dee embena rara dupwa jingi para pyao para lao lalu lao langilyu.
Emba kumarene dokopa embena rora ambasu dupwa pipya role pyao malu pirami. Dokopa nambame embena ikinyi dokona mende kiŋi rombo palyaro. Dopa pirunupa banya kiŋi yulu doko porai ingyuo ando para.
Doo kiŋi rombo palyuo kararono dokome nambana tembole anda pyakara. Dee nambame banya manjo paramo dupwanako akali dupwa kiŋi ingyarapu palyuo puu parami lao rombo palyarapu piru.
Namba banya rakange ingyaro dee baa nambana ikinyingi ingyuo para. Baa koo piramo dokopa rakangeme banya ikinyingi pyalana pyuo randa mainginyili pyuo randa mairu.
Dokona nambana mona reto alowa pii nange renge doko Sole keta nyisa nyiyu doko suu pyao baa keta nyisa nyii naro. Sole keta dopa piyunu doko emba banya panda nyuo kiŋi karalase lao piyu.

Yuu peparae emba wane manjo jingi parape lao puu pare. Nambame embena kiŋi yulu doko sulu jinya lao piru. Dee nambame embena rara dokona akali dupwa iki embena panda nyuo kiŋi inginya lao rombo palyarapu pyuo puu paro, lapya, lamaipi, leya.
Anatumi nolakao epo lamaiyamo dupwa peparae Netaneme Dapiti lamaiya.
Dapitimi Anatu Ange Lao AteŋaLeya Doko

Kiŋi Dapiti baa Kamongona komau anda dokona kolando pao banya lenge kambu dokona isa pisipala ateŋa lao lao, Kamongo Mupwa Andake Wakasa doko, embame wambo nambana lao yulu pipinyi dupwa nambape dee nambana ree palu dupwa yulu keyange pimwandena pipinde daa.

Kamongo Mupwa Andake Wakasa doko, epapu embame kamame wakasako ingyuo pilini. Dee ee kana ene eparamo dupwana embame nambana para pyasi dupwa kando apa pyakare dupwana lao lalu lao lapi. Dokona embame namba lasaka pipi kandapi.
Dokona nambame emba aki mende konda pyuo langiru. Namba embena kendemande akali embame soo gisilini.
Doo yulu andake pipinyi dupwa embena yulu pinya suu pyapinyili pyuo pipi. Embame namba yulu andake pipinyi dupwa see, lao langipi.
Emba ama ketaele, Kamongo Mupwa Andake Wakasa doko. Emba yale mendali kara nange. Namwame yuu peparae emba iki Anatu karenge lao soo nyilyamano.

Isaraele wambu karapusi ingyuo kendemande yulu pyuo kareyaminyipa embena rangena wambu ingyuo kiiramo nyuo lanyuo epee kande. Yuu mupwa dupwa peparaena Isaraele rara dopale rara mende pali nange. Embame yulu andake keyange dupwa namwa keta pii dokome yuu muu dusipana embena kingi doko ketae pelyamo. Isaraele wambu Isipi piso emba rangena ingyuo manda rao nyingi dupwa nakama epo palena laro karo dokopa embame wambu rara wakale dupwape nakamana mee bange anatu lenge dupwape pyao nembee.
Isaraele dupwa embame emba rangena wambu ingyuo puu parami lao rombo palyapala emba Kamongo doko namwana Anatu angingyuo karenge.
Dokona epapu Kamongo Anatu, nambape nambana ree palu dupwape kando embame mende piru lao lalu lao lee kande doko pipi. Dee dopaleko yuu peparae pyuo karalu karape.

Dokopa embena kingi doko ketae para. Dopa piramopa wambu dupwame laoko karo, Kamongo Porai Wakasa doko Isaraele peparae keta karamo, larami. Embame nambana rara dokona akali dupwa iki kiŋi ingyuo karena lao yuu gii peparae rombo palyarapu piri.

Kamongo Porai Wakasa Isaraele wambunya Anatu. Embame yulu pyakarene dupwa peparae namba nolakao langyuo dee nambana rara dokona akali dupwa kiŋi ingyuo karena laro langii kande dokome namba paka nao emba kando ateŋa dake langilyu.
Dokona epapu Kamongo Mupwa Andake Wakasa doko emba Anatu. Emba lalu lao lenge pii doko alowa pii nao minyuo karalu karenge. Lalu lao lenge pii keyange dake namba keta langii kande.

Nambame nambana wambu dupwa elyape keta pisinyi dopaleko ingyuo pisakape lao emba piso silyu. Emba Kamongo Mupwa Andake Wakasa dokome dopa lao lalu lao leene dokome embena elyape pisingi renge doko nambana para pyasi dupwa keta palyuo puu para, leya.
8:1-18 Dapitimi yuu liti wakale range lapo Isaraele repeta kareyaminyi dupwa nyuo anamasi minyapala baa Isaraele dokona kiŋi angingyuo karo yuu peparaena iso kareya.
